description.value: The Jubilee Arts Centre is a community arts venue housed in the historic MSA Centennial Library Building in downtown Abbotsford, jointly operated by the Abbotsford Arts Council and the Abbotsford Downtown Business Association. Situated at Jubilee Park on South Fraser Way, it functions as a cultural gathering point for local arts events, exhibitions, and community programming. Touring cyclists passing through downtown Abbotsford will find it in the civic core, close to other downtown services.
